findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_methodology_versions, get_feed, find_business_buyer · Private data: verify_lender, get_methodology_versions, recommend_lender, recommend_service_provider, get_document_checklist, report_repayment · Public sink: request_brand_attestation, get_brand_attestation_status, get_document_checklist, request_partner_referral, quote_credit_terms, report_repayment · Destructive: cart.updateLineQuantity, cart.removeLine.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_methodology_versions, get_feed, find_business_buyer · Private data: verify_lender, get_methodology_versions, recommend_lender, recommend_service_provider, get_document_checklist, report_repayment · Public sink: request_brand_attestation, get_brand_attestation_status, get_document_checklist, request_partner_referral, quote_credit_terms, report_repayment · Destructive: cart.updateLineQuantity, cart.removeLine

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
